scope: Explain the frozen seed-42 joint-training gate failure without changing the trained checkpoints, tuning a loss weight, switching streams, or accessing pilot/final test.

engineering_findings.interpretation: The integration path and supervision routing worked. The expansion failure is an optimization/evaluation result, not evidence that an auxiliary objective was silently absent.

passed_protection_checks: complete AP drop versus JP within 0.05
JALL BoN@16 regression versus J0 within 0.02
JALL BoN@16 regression versus JP within 0.02

standalone_sparse_hallucination.implication: The sparse labels and head previously produced a signal above both position baselines; the JALL failure cannot be attributed solely to unusable labels.

jall_sparse_hallucination.implication: The joint run fit the sparse objective materially less well than the standalone S1 run.

joint_prior.implication: The original prior objective remained active and learned in both cells, but JALL fit it less well and lost held-out key AP relative to JP. The original mutual and shared-gradient gate were not replaced.

joint_consistency.implication: The consistency objective strongly changed the representation geometry, but only on training relations; this is not held-out semantic-equivalence evidence.

batching_difference.standalone_hallucination: 48 mechanism rows are the complete dataset and form 12 ordinary batches per epoch.
batching_difference.joint_single_stream: The same 48 rows are singleton semantic groups interleaved with the 3968-row correctness stream and appear in 45-48 active batches per epoch.
batching_difference.controlled: Every row is still exposed exactly once per epoch in all joint cells.
batching_difference.not_controlled_against_standalone: Auxiliary batch packing, optimizer-step context, and the number of intervening correctness-only updates differ from the standalone localization run.

identified: The full retained objective failed the frozen localization and key-prior expansion gates at seed 42.
The failure is compatible with optimization interference or supervision-mixing effects.
The current result does not authorize seeds 43 and 44.
not_identified: Whether hallucination supervision alone is sufficient to cause the key-prior drop.
Whether consistency supervision alone is sufficient to cause the key-prior drop.
Whether the failure is caused by either objective individually or only their interaction.
Whether changing loss weights, batch packing, or stream structure would repair the result.
causal_boundary.reason: Relative to JP, JALL adds hallucination and consistency at the same time, so the existing three-cell matrix cannot separate their effects.

must_hold_fixed: the project's original direct plus bidirectional stop-gradient mutual plus shared-gradient gate prior objective

interpretation_table.jpc_key_drop: Consistency is sufficient, conditional on the original prior, to reproduce key-prior degradation.
interpretation_table.jph_key_drop: Sparse hallucination supervision is sufficient, conditional on the original prior, to reproduce key-prior degradation.
interpretation_table.neither_drop_but_jall_drops: The failure requires an interaction between hallucination and consistency under this protocol.
interpretation_table.jph_hallucination_passes: Consistency is implicated in the JALL hallucination-localization failure.
interpretation_table.jph_hallucination_fails: First compare current semantic-group packing with preregistered supervision-aware packing while preserving one exposure per row; do not infer a loss-weight fix yet.

decision: Keep the original dual-prior method and all disabled-module decisions unchanged. Do not expand JALL to more seeds. Seek approval for the two-cell matched drop-one diagnosis before changing weights or batching.
